title: Delicate Arch Trail
map_label: A 3D walk from the Wolfe Ranch trailhead across the slickrock to Delicate Arch.

stops.file: Delicate Arch Trail, Arches National Park, Utah (2408102243).jpg
stops.title: Delicate Arch Trailhead
stops.alt: The trail sign at the Wolfe Ranch trailhead, with a map of the route to Delicate Arch.
stops.text: The route starts here, near Wolfe Ranch. The trail crosses a bridge, then climbs slickrock to the arch.

stops.file: Ute Indian Petroglyphs Delicate Arch Trail Arches National Park UT 20220407 164616108.jpg
stops.title: Ute petroglyphs
stops.alt: Ute rock art on a sandstone wall beside the Delicate Arch trail.
stops.text: A short spur off the trail leads to a wall of Ute rock art, early in the walk.

stops.title: Delicate Arch
stops.alt: Delicate Arch standing on the rim of a slickrock bowl in low light.
stops.text: You have reached Delicate Arch, a free-standing arch on the edge of a slickrock bowl.
